about: Two-level taxonomy of the explorer's concepts: the four classical aims (aram, porul, inbam, veedu) and nine cross-cutting families. Every concept has one primary subtheme ('concepts') and may be listed as secondary ('also') elsewhere. Glosses and essence lines are written for this graph from its own concept glosses and verse readings; no translation or commentary text. 'keywords' are extra search words (Sanskrit or English equivalents, and the concept list's aliases).

categories.name: Virtue and conduct
categories.gloss: The first aim: right conduct, character, and the duties of the household and of friendship.
categories.gloss_ta: அறம்: ஒழுக்கம், பண்பு, இல்லறக் கடமை, நட்பு
categories.essence: Across the ethics books and beyond, virtue is judged by whether the mind matches the act: giving goes with a glad face, truth is measured by its harmlessness, restraint guards the senses, and harm done is said to return to the doer.

subthemes.name: Virtue as order
subthemes.gloss: Virtue named as the order of life: conduct, rule, fairness, measure and purity of means.

subthemes.name: Character and its marks
subthemes.gloss: What makes a person great or small: worth, honour, shame, renown and blame.

subthemes.name: Restraint and the vices
subthemes.gloss: Self-restraint and forbearance set against anger, envy, craving, pride and the vices of liquor and dice.

subthemes.name: Giving and kindness
subthemes.gloss: Giving, hospitality, service to the community, compassion and the kindly eye; and the refusal that withholds.

subthemes.name: Speech and truth
subthemes.gloss: The spoken word: truthfulness, pleasant and harsh speech, backbiting, rebuke and keeping a confidence.

subthemes.name: Not harming
subthemes.gloss: Not killing, not eating flesh, not stealing, not deceiving: the rules against harm and its return on the doer.

subthemes.name: The household
subthemes.gloss: Household life: the wife and her steadfastness, children, kin and the chaste wife's power.

subthemes.name: Friendship and enmity
subthemes.gloss: Choosing, testing and keeping friends; old bonds and their claims; quarrel and hidden enmity.

categories.name: Wealth, polity and the world
categories.gloss: The second aim: the king and his state, war, wealth and work, patronage and the city.
categories.gloss_ta: பொருள்: அரசு, போர், செல்வம், உழைப்பு, கொடை, நகர்
categories.essence: Wealth is praised for what it lets one give and blamed when hoarded; the ethics books tie the king to the just sceptre as the world is tied to rain, and the puram poems measure a king by his gifts to bards and his valour in the field.

subthemes.name: Kingship and rule
subthemes.gloss: The king and his sceptre, just or bent; punishment, dread, tribute and the wheel of sovereignty.

subthemes.name: Counsel and statecraft
subthemes.gloss: Ministers, counsel, spies and envoys, the assembly, strength weighed, place and time for acting.

subthemes.name: War and valour
subthemes.gloss: Armies and forts, valour and fearlessness, vows before battle, cattle raids, camps and the feasts of the field.

subthemes.name: Wealth and its loss
subthemes.gloss: Wealth, poverty and ruin; asking and being refused; bondage as the end of want.

subthemes.name: Effort and work
subthemes.gloss: Effort, sustained labour and drive, set against sloth and heedlessness; farming as the base of all work.

subthemes.name: Bards and patrons
subthemes.gloss: The bard's gift and the asking for it, the guide poem and the bard's small drum at the patron's gate.

subthemes.name: Land, city and market
subthemes.gloss: The realm as a living whole, the royal city and its market streets.

categories.name: Love
categories.gloss: The third aim: secret love and marriage, union, the sulk, separation and longing.
categories.essence: Love is read through the body and the land: the friend speaks for the lovers, gossip and the mother's watch press toward marriage, slipping bangles and pallor testify in separation before the woman speaks, and the sulk is prized only in measure.

subthemes.name: Desire and beauty
subthemes.gloss: Desire and joy, beauty that wounds, the eyes as love's agents, infatuation and the heart spoken to.

subthemes.name: Secret love
subthemes.gloss: Love before marriage: meetings by day and night, union, reading signs, keeping it hidden, and the town's gossip.

subthemes.name: Toward marriage
subthemes.gloss: Pressing for marriage, the girl shut in, disclosure to the family, elopement, the palmyra horse and the wedding.

subthemes.name: Separation and longing
subthemes.gloss: Parting and its marks on the body: pallor, wasting, remembering, dreams and the sickness of love.

subthemes.name: The sulk and the other woman
subthemes.gloss: The lovers' quarrel, the courtesan and the man's straying, broken oaths.

subthemes.name: Omens and divining love
subthemes.gloss: Omens, overheard words, the sand circle, and the diviners called to read a girl's illness.

subthemes.name: Love at play
subthemes.gloss: The herders' bull-catch and round dance, water-play in the flood.

categories.name: Release
categories.gloss: The fourth aim: renouncing, the bonds that hold the soul, the round of births and the states of release.
categories.essence: Birth is the evil and craving its seed: the Naladiyar, Tirumanthiram and Siddhars counsel giving up and knowing, the Saiva texts grade release up to union with Siva, and the Jain and Buddhist epics give it to the three jewels or the perfections.

subthemes.name: Renunciation and austerity
subthemes.gloss: Giving up, austerity, attachment and its cutting, silence, and the ascetic's garb true or false.

subthemes.name: The bonds of the soul
subthemes.gloss: Impurity, the bound soul and its bonds, maya and the adjuncts that cling.

subthemes.name: Birth, rebirth and the next world
subthemes.gloss: The round of births, the four courses, the lowest life, hell, the gods and the world to come.

subthemes.name: The states of release
subthemes.gloss: Release itself and its grades: union, nearness, stillness, bliss and fullness.

subthemes.name: Knowledge and the paths
subthemes.gloss: Liberating knowledge and the four Saiva paths, Vedanta and Siddhanta, the great saying.

subthemes.name: Void and the absolute
subthemes.gloss: The void, the subtle, the beginningless and Brahman: names for what is left when all else goes.

subthemes.name: Jain and Buddhist ways
subthemes.gloss: The three jewels, the ford-makers, the perfections of the bodhisattva.

categories.name: The body and medicine
categories.gloss: The body as frame and as impurity, disease and remedy, food and hunger, the arts of long life.
categories.gloss_ta: உடல்: யாக்கை, நோய், மருந்து, உணவு, காயகற்பம்
categories.essence: The body is a frame that will not last, a leaking pot in the Naladiyar and a womb-born thing the Siddhars use to shame pride of caste; yet the Tirumanthiram and Siddhars also make it the field of practice, kept alive by breath, kalpa and nectar.

subthemes.name: The body's frame
subthemes.gloss: The perishable body, its forming in the womb and the impurity it is born from.

subthemes.name: Disease and remedy
subthemes.gloss: Sickness and the medicine that answers it.

subthemes.name: Food and hunger
subthemes.gloss: Hunger, eating and the measure of food.

subthemes.name: Long life and alchemy
subthemes.gloss: The span of life, the rejuvenating kalpa, alchemy and the nectar said to preserve the body.

categories.name: Mind, perception and consciousness
categories.gloss: The mind and its steadiness, delusion, the senses, and the states of consciousness.
categories.essence: The mind decides what an act is worth: outward observance without a clean mind is show; Tirumular maps waking, dream and sleep onto the tattvas, and the debate epics argue whether awareness is a lasting soul, a stream of moments or the elements combined.

subthemes.name: The mind and its steadiness
subthemes.gloss: The inner state of mind, equanimity, settled trust and fear as a moral faculty.

subthemes.name: Drive and firmness
subthemes.gloss: Energy of mind and firmness in execution.

subthemes.name: Ego and delusion
subthemes.gloss: Pride and the ego's self-importance, folly and petty understanding.

subthemes.name: Senses and perception
subthemes.gloss: The sense faculties and the perception of what is truly so.

subthemes.name: States of consciousness
subthemes.gloss: Waking, dream, sleep and beyond; the three gunas matched to them.

categories.name: The divine and devotion
categories.gloss: The Lord and his grace, devotion and service, gods and spirits, shrines and emblems, sects and their harmony.
categories.gloss_ta: இறை: இறைவன், அருள், பத்தி, தெய்வங்கள், தலம்
categories.essence: The Kural names the Lord only by epithet, the Paripadal and Thiruppugazh praise Thirumal and Murugan, and the Tirumanthiram teaches Siva pervading all; across them grace comes to those who take refuge at his feet, while the Siddhars mock sect and outward rite.

subthemes.name: The Lord
subthemes.gloss: God named and unnamed: Siva, his power, his five acts, his dance, his light and his pervading all things.

subthemes.name: Grace and refuge
subthemes.gloss: The Lord's grace, his holy feet and the act of taking refuge in him.

subthemes.name: Devotion and service
subthemes.gloss: Devotion, service, the community of devotees, worship, reciting the name, and reviling the holy.

subthemes.name: Gods, goddesses and spirits
subthemes.gloss: Murugan's bride, the war goddess, guardian spirits and the Buddha worshipped at his seat.

subthemes.name: Shrines and emblems
subthemes.gloss: Sacred sites, the lingam, holy ash, holy waters and the monastery.

subthemes.name: Sects and their harmony
subthemes.gloss: Religious systems, Saivism, and the Siddhar stance of concord among faiths.

subthemes.name: Saiva cosmology
subthemes.gloss: The tattvas and paths, nada and bindu, the cosmic egg, sun, space and the eight directions.

categories.name: Practice and yoga
categories.gloss: Breath, the channels and centres of the yogic body, the limbs of yoga, mantra and the guru's secret teaching.
categories.gloss_ta: யோகம்: வாசி, நாடி, குண்டலினி, மந்திரம், குரு
categories.essence: In the Tirumanthiram and the Siddhar songs the breath is the practice: ridden like a horse, held in the channels and raised through the centres to the crown where sun and moon become one, written in cipher and given only by a guru.

subthemes.name: Breath
subthemes.gloss: The breath ridden like a horse, prana and its control, the channels, the central channel and the inner gate.

subthemes.name: Centres and the coiled power
subthemes.gloss: Kundalini, the six supports, the maiden in the body, the crown of the egg, and the body as cosmos.

subthemes.name: The limbs of yoga
subthemes.gloss: Yoga, posture, meditation, absorption, gestures and the powers it brings.

subthemes.name: Mantra and sound
subthemes.gloss: The mantra, the five letters, Om, the drawn diagram and the spell-lore of the Vidyadharas.

subthemes.name: The guru and the secret word
subthemes.gloss: The guru and the disciple, and the Siddhars' cipher that hides the practice.

categories.name: Nature and landscape
categories.gloss: Rain and water, the seasons and hours, the wild road and the work of the land.
categories.gloss_ta: இயற்கை: மழை, பருவம், நெறி, திணையும் கருவும்
categories.essence: Rain is the condition of life and the image of just rule; in the akam poems the seasons and the hour of evening keep time for love, the promised rains stand as proof of the absent man's return, and the wild road carries both danger and knowledge.

subthemes.name: Rain
subthemes.gloss: Rain as the condition of life and of virtue.

subthemes.name: Seasons and hours
subthemes.gloss: The cold season, young spring, the promised season of return and evening.

subthemes.name: The wild road
subthemes.gloss: The road through wild country and the knowledge that lets a traveller pass.

subthemes.name: Land and its work
subthemes.gloss: Ploughing and the base of society.

categories.name: Society, caste and ritual
categories.gloss: Birth and lineage, pollution and purity, sacrifice and offering, vows and curses, women's lot and captivity.
categories.gloss_ta: சமூகம்: பிறப்பு, குடி, தீட்டு, வேள்வி, நோன்பு
categories.essence: The books pull both ways on birth: the Kural makes conduct flow from good family and also makes family a name earned by conduct, the Siddhars turn the womb's impurity against caste, and the Jain epics turn on refusing blood sacrifice.

subthemes.name: Birth, lineage and caste
subthemes.gloss: Birth as social origin, lineage, the Brahmin, old houses of fighters, and ritual pollution.

subthemes.name: Sacrifice and offering
subthemes.gloss: The Vedic sacrifice and the fire oblation, blood offerings to fierce deities, human sacrifice and rites for the dead.

subthemes.name: Vows, oaths and curses
subthemes.gloss: Religious vows, fasting unto death, curses that bind and blessings that wish well.

subthemes.name: Women's lot
subthemes.gloss: Widowhood and its observances, and women who sell intimacy.

subthemes.name: Festivals and public life
subthemes.gloss: The festival of a god or a town.

subthemes.name: Bondage and prison
subthemes.gloss: The king's prison and captivity.

categories.name: Knowledge and debate
categories.gloss: Learning and its lack, the means of valid knowledge, debate between schools, and the schools' accounts of the world.
categories.gloss_ta: அறிவாய்வு: கல்வி, அளவை, வாதம், சமயக் கொள்கைகள்
categories.essence: Learning is the wealth that does not decay, yet conduct can cancel it and fate can limit it; the Manimekalai and Neelakesi stage formal debate in which Buddhist, Jain, Ajivika, Sankhya and materialist views are tried by the means of valid knowledge.

subthemes.name: Learning
subthemes.gloss: Learning by study and by listening, understanding, and the state of the unlearned.

subthemes.name: Means of knowing
subthemes.gloss: Valid means of knowledge, false semblances in inference, and formal debate before the king.

subthemes.name: Buddhist accounts
subthemes.gloss: Dependent arising, the aggregates, the moment, the continuum, traces, causes that ripen and the world-system.

subthemes.name: Jain accounts
subthemes.gloss: Extended existents, standpoints, and the clairvoyance of the Jain ascetic.

subthemes.name: Other schools
subthemes.gloss: Ajivika fixity, Sankhya nature, materialism, atoms, qualities and transformation.

subthemes.name: Scripture and tradition
subthemes.gloss: The Veda, the Agamas, the old accounts and the proverb as proof.

categories.name: Poetics, grammar and the arts
categories.gloss: The Tamil language and the poet's word, implication, the genres of puram poetry, music, dance and the told story.
categories.gloss_ta: புலமை: தமிழ், இலக்கணம், துறை, இசை, கூத்து
categories.essence: Tamil stands beside Sanskrit as a tongue of revelation in the Tirumanthiram, the Paripadal weighs Madurai on the balance of learning, the puram poems turn battle and grief into named kinds of song, and the epics treat music and dance-drama as learned arts.

subthemes.name: Language and meaning
subthemes.gloss: Tamil as the poet's medium and a tongue of revelation, and implication as a way words mean.

subthemes.name: Genres and occasions
subthemes.gloss: The battlefield as threshing floor and the lament of helpless grief, as kinds of poem.

subthemes.name: Music and dance
subthemes.gloss: Music and the lute, dance-drama as a learned art.

subthemes.name: The told story
subthemes.gloss: The Buddha's birth tales and the old accounts.

categories.name: Time, death and impermanence
categories.gloss: Impermanence and age, fate and the deed's return, death and its rites, suffering, and cosmic time.
categories.gloss_ta: காலம்: நிலையாமை, ஊழ், வினை, சாக்காடு, ஊழி
categories.essence: Youth, wealth and the body pass like lightning and Death roams looking for his own, so give and do good now; former deeds return to the doer, though the Kural lets unflagging effort see fate's back, and the puram poems answer death with hero-stones and renown.

subthemes.name: Impermanence
subthemes.gloss: What passes: youth, the body's strength, wealth and life itself.

subthemes.name: Fate and the deed
subthemes.gloss: Fate, the deed and its fruit, causes that ripen and curses that come to fruit.

subthemes.name: Death and its rites
subthemes.gloss: Death personified and faced, the cremation ground, fasting to death facing north, the hero-stone.

subthemes.name: Suffering and loss
subthemes.gloss: Affliction and hardship as the lot of the living.

subthemes.name: Cosmic time
subthemes.gloss: The ages of the world's making and unmaking.
